name: Buzzetty Price Comparison Tables
author: buzzettycom

sections.description:
Buzzetty Price Comparison Tables helps you build clear, conversion-focused comparison tables without custom code.

Use it for product roundups, SaaS plan pages, service packages, and feature comparisons. Build once in the admin interface, then place anywhere with a shortcode.

Key Features

  • Visual matrix-style builder for products (columns) and features (rows)
  • Responsive frontend output (desktop table, mobile card layout)
  • Three included themes: Simple, Professional, Modern
  • Per-table accent and highlight color controls
  • Product highlighting and badge labels
  • Shortcode support for posts, pages, and widget areas
  • Dedicated custom post type for easy table management

Perfect For

  • Affiliate marketers comparing products
  • SaaS companies displaying pricing plans
  • Review sites comparing features
  • E-commerce stores showcasing product differences
  • Service providers presenting package options

How It Works

  1. Create a new comparison table from the WordPress admin
  2. Add products/plans as columns
  3. Add features/specifications as rows
  4. Fill in the comparison data
  5. Customize colors and styling
  6. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any post or page

Themes Included

  • Simple – Clean, minimalist design
  • Professional – Business-focused layout with subtle gradients
  • Modern – Contemporary design with bold styling
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Buzzetty Price Comparison Tables”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu

After Activation

  1. Go to Price Tables in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Click Add New to create your first comparison table
  3. Use the visual builder to add products and features
  4. Publish the table and copy the shortcode
  5. Paste the shortcode into any post or page
sections.faq:
How do I display a table on my site?

After creating and publishing a table, copy the shortcode from the sidebar and paste it into any post, page, or widget area that supports shortcodes.

Example: [buzzpct_table id=”123″]

Can I customize the colors?

Yes! Each table has customizable accent and highlight colors. You can set these in the table builder under the “Styling” section.

Is the table responsive?

Absolutely! The tables automatically adapt to different screen sizes. On desktop, they display as traditional tables. On mobile devices, they transform into easy-to-read card layouts.

How many products can I compare?

There is no strict hard limit, but for best readability we recommend 3-5 products per table.

Can I use multiple tables on one page?

Yes! You can embed as many comparison tables as you need on a single page using their respective shortcodes.

What themes are available?

The free version includes three themes: Simple, Professional, and Modern. Each theme has a distinct visual style to match different website designs.

Can I reorder products or features?

Products and features are displayed in the order you add them. You can remove and re-add items to adjust order.

Is this plugin compatible with page builders?

Yes! The shortcode works with all major page builders including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, and others that support WordPress shortcodes.

Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. The plugin does not send data to external services and does not include tracking by default.
